If a fetus turns out to be gay, that individual deserves love and advocacy. Protecting the lives and humanity of gay or lgbt individuals is an major component of being pro-life. We need to acknowledge the epidemic of loneliness and the heightened rates of suicide and self-harm within the gay or lgbt community as a whole. Similarly, we should regonize undocumented immigrants, children born to them, African American lives, the elderly, homeless, underprivileged, those in need of healthcare, students fearing school due to gun violence, and other vulnerable groups. Being pro-life includes all of these issues. I have always been morally opposed abortion and will continue to be, but this is only the starting point of what being pro life really truly means.
